organization.name: Freshworks Inc.
organization.notes: Freshworks incorporated in Delaware in 2010. Official 2017 rebranding announcement distinguishes Freshdesk company origins from product names. Current 2026 results confirm Nasdaq FRSH. Historical investors:Accel, Tiger Global Management, Capital G, Sequoia Capital India; current stakes not asserted. Freshservice ITAM is a productline, not a separatecorporation.

pricingTiers.name: ITAM Growth
pricingTiers.notes: ITAM Growth is lowest listed plan; no amount published in extracted content. Packs of 500 weighted Asset Units:desktop 1, server/VM/network 4. Not a flat per-device or agent price; contact Sales for configuration.
Pro is labeled Premier value; no explicit Most popular/Recommended designation verified.

pricingTiers.name: ITAM Pro
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational tier: ITAM Pro adds software assetmanagement, Saa Sdiscovery and normalization. New Freshservice for IT Growth/Pro/Enterprise required for additional Growthunits or ITAMPro/Enterprise upgrades; ITAMamountunverified.

pricingTiers.name: ITAM Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Named ITAMEnterprise with no amount exposed. Sales contact exists, explicit quote requirement not verified. Dependency mapping included; do not substitute general Freshservice agent-seat prices.

moats.claim: Asset, service and operations context in one platform can create workflow and data relationships that raise migration costs; value depends on accurate inventory.

productReasons.claim: Discovery, CMDB and lifecycle management provide a common inventory of hardware and hybrid infrastructure.
Software/Saa S discovery, normalization and contract/purchase-order tracking connect inventory to licensed usage.
DCIM rack/cable views and application/business-service mapping show physical and logical dependencies.
